correctness.rationale: For a W state the product-test purity identity reduces acceptance to one half of one plus the sum of squared probabilities. In the all-coefficients-at-most-one-half regime, the published circumradius formula converts fixed overlap to a relation between the product and this second moment. A trigonometric parameterization of triples with fixed sum and second moment shows the product is minimized exactly at one-small/two-equal triples, and monotone inversion yields the announced frontier and equality states. Above one half, the product overlap is the largest coefficient and convexity pushes the remaining mass to one boundary coefficient. Fresh checks on 100,000 random W triples found no violation, and 101 equality-family points matched the closed frontier to numerical precision.

originality.rationale: The 2026 product-test theorem gives the exact dimension-free curve with arbitrary local dimensions; it is a valid upper benchmark but does not give the optimum within the three-qubit W family. The older W-state literature supplies the exact product-overlap branches but never optimizes product-test acceptance at fixed overlap. The audited constrained simplex optimization and equality classification therefore fill a genuine canonical fixed-family problem, and no equivalent Resultary finding was located.

value.rationale: The generalized W family is the canonical three-qubit family containing the globally geometrically most-entangled W state. The exact fixed-overlap frontier quantifies a genuine fixed-dimension obstruction to the newly solved dimension-free problem and provides a sharp benchmark with complete equality classification.

final_claim: Within the closed generalized three-qubit W family, the exact product-test acceptance frontier at fixed squared product overlap is the stated two-branch curve: a one-small/two-equal interior family on overlap from 4/9 to 1/2 and a two-qubit boundary family above 1/2; on the low-overlap interval it is strictly below the dimension-free product-test curve by the stated positive deficit.
limitations: This is a complete result only within the generalized W family, not the full fixed three-qubit state space.
